body.label: Target
body.html: One enemy within melee Weapon Range.

surges.html: On a hit, move 1 unit around the target without triggering its movement Reactions.
Deal +1 Damage if the target already took Damage since its last turn.

rider.title: Combo - Finisher
rider.html: After a hit, spend 3 Combo to prevent the target from making movement Reactions until the start of your next turn and move up to 2 units away from it.
